title: One scratch-git helper for every test, enforced by a lint
summary: Every test that used to start `git` itself now goes through a single shared helper, `common::scratch_git`, which runs git from an empty environment against a directory confined to the temp root. The helper is compiled twice — into each integration test as `common::scratch_git`, and by path into the library's unit tests — so unit and integration tests share one implementation. A new tree-sitter-based test, `test_git_discipline`, parses every `.rs` file under `crates/*/src` and `crates/*/tests` and fails the build if test code calls `Command::new("git")` or names `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE`/`GIT_INDEX_FILE`/`GIT_COMMON_DIR`. Production code gains two small pieces: `scrub_locating_git_env` (used by `moon` so a nested moon finds its own repository) and a scrubbed `merge_base`. The old nested-cargo sentinel tests are replaced by real hook-run tests that no longer set git variables themselves.

nodes.subtitle: builder, checkpoint, clean_copy, config, git, changeset_tests

nodes.label: tests/common/mod.rs
nodes.subtitle: TempRepo, BareRepo, git_with_hook_env
nodes.summary: The shared test fixtures now delegate to `scratch_git`; `TempRepo::git` and `git_with_hook_env` pass their extra environment through `run_with_env` instead of building commands by hand.

nodes.label: scratch_git
nodes.subtitle: run_with_env / run / ok / init / init_bare
nodes.summary: Runs `git -C dir` from a cleared environment with an empty HOME, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`, so no global or system config is read. `confine_to_temp_root` refuses relative paths, `..` and anything resolving outside the temp root. `init` sets a fixed identity and disables commit signing.

nodes.label: confine_to_temp_root
nodes.subtitle: resolves symlinks and `..`, asserts under temp
nodes.summary: Canonicalises the nearest existing parent and appends the missing components, then asserts the result starts with the canonical temp root.

nodes.label: empty_home
nodes.subtitle: temp_root/osf-scratch-git-empty-home
nodes.summary: A shared empty folder standing in for HOME, so no `~/.gitconfig` is read by a scratch git call.

nodes.label: git.rs
nodes.subtitle: scrub_git_env_for_dir, merge_base, INDEX_FILE_VAR
nodes.summary: Adds `INDEX_FILE_VAR` and `scrub_locating_git_env`, routes `scrub_with_index` through it, and makes `merge_base` scrub its environment like every other git call.

nodes.label: scrub_locating_git_env
nodes.subtitle: removes LOCATING_VARS only
nodes.summary: Removes only the `GIT_*` variables that name which repository to use, leaving `GIT_INDEX_FILE` and everything else alone. Used by `scrub_with_index` and by moon.

nodes.label: merge_base
nodes.subtitle: now scrubs before running git
nodes.summary: Previously ran `git merge-base` with the inherited environment; now calls `scrub_git_env_for_dir` first, so an inherited `GIT_DIR` cannot redirect it.

nodes.label: moon.rs
nodes.subtitle: strip_inherited_moon_vars
nodes.summary: The nested-moon launcher now also strips the repository-locating `GIT_*` variables, so moon finds the repository from its working directory rather than a caller's `GIT_DIR`.

nodes.label: assets.rs
nodes.subtitle: run_git
nodes.summary: The asset publisher's git runner now scrubs its environment for the target directory before running.

nodes.label: test_git_discipline
nodes.subtitle: tree-sitter parse of every crate source
nodes.summary: Walks `crates/*/src` and `crates/*/tests`, parses each file with the Rust grammar, and in test code (a `tests/` file, `#![cfg(test)]`, or an item marked `#[cfg(test)]`/`#[test]`) refuses `Command::new("git")` and string literals naming the four locating variables. The helper and the rule's own source are exempt.

nodes.label: tree-sitter-rust
nodes.subtitle: grammar used to parse test code
nodes.summary: The Rust grammar the discipline test parses every source file with; a file that fails to parse fails the check.
